correctness.rationale: Exhaustive face generation verifies all 21-edge-subset possibilities for K7 against the 175 forbidden 3-star/triangle triples, yielding 14,430 nonempty simplices. The exact repeated-toggle partial matching covers 7,106 pairs, and a complete directed Hasse topological sort covers all 14,430 vertices and 69,762 codimension-one arrows, proving acyclicity. Integer oriented gradient-path projection gives a 36-by-181 Morse boundary with 35 unit Smith factors and one zero; its unit attaching maps cancel at the CW level because the lower positive skeleton is a wedge of 4-spheres and pi_4 is classified by degrees. Independent mod-two boundary ranks confirm one H4 and 146 H5. The lower n3..6 matching counts and n6 unit Smith factor are similarly exhaustive. No infinite-n extrapolation.

value.rationale: This is a complete integral homotopy classification of a natural initial segment of the recently studied clique-free family on canonical triangular graphs. The first mixed-dimensional case n=7 has a nontrivial 35-dimensional unit Morse attaching matrix, contrasting with pure sphere wedges at n<=6. It is not a cosmetic restatement, a known table or a tiny improvement: it identifies exact degree-and-multiplicity information unavailable from optimization of a single maximum matching and supplies a reproducible benchmark for higher-clique-free topology.
